verdict.rationale: Adyen's docs show a fast API-based Checkout integration (single /sessions call) and per-transaction pricing with no setup fees, suggesting quick technical onboarding, but community evidence indicates Adyen commonly rejects small/early-stage merchants and imposes minimum volumes/reserves that keep founders from even getting approved to accept payments quickly. This directly contradicts the 'within a day of signing up' premise for a typical founder-scale business.
